title: Book Three · Chapter 95: The Large Price Card
story:
On Thursday, Ronan buys a large sheet of paper from Mr Qiu.

It costs one yuan. Leo agrees to use the shared money. Ronan writes the cost beside the other sale costs.

Twenty-five yuan remain in their envelope. The stock is still twenty-one books, with six set aside for Mr Wei.

Ronan writes Used Books across the new sheet. The letters are much larger than the first price card. Under them, he puts the price and Saturday's hours.

“People can see that from the corner,” Leo says.

Ronan holds it up. Mr Qiu points to the side of the table. The sheet can hang there tomorrow night, clear of the doorway.

That afternoon, Ronan meets Anna outside the library. She has checked the route for their visit.

“The group comes back here about one,” she says. “We can bring water and something small to eat.”

Ronan nods. He has kept his personal bus money apart.

Anna shows him the two names on her reply sheet. Hers and his.

“Nine here,” she says.

“I know.”

“You will come from home?”

“Yes. Leo will be at the table.”

He can tell her about Mr Wei now. The new time is in his notebook. He keeps his hand over the closed cover.

“You sound busy,” she says.

“We have six books set aside. Maybe more people will come this week.”

“Good.”

She smiles, and he smiles back. She tells him about one question for the guide. She wants to know how a drawing changes after the workers start a building.

Ronan listens. Then he tells her about the large price card.

Anna touches his wrist near the blue cord.

“Saturday will be a full day.”

“A good one.”

They walk together as far as the crossing. Ronan almost mentions the early handover again. He thinks of five short minutes and says nothing.

At home, Leo has finished the price lines on their list. Every book is still two yuan.

Ronan tells him the visit group will return about one.

“You need to get on the first bus,” Leo says. “The one at a quarter past nine.”

“I will.”

Leo puts his own breakfast plan beside Saturday. He will arrive early and stay until eleven.

Ronan hangs the large paper inside the room for now. From the yard, the words look clear and strong.

He stands at the gate and reads them once more. Behind him, Anna's small visit sheet is still closed inside his notebook.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

set aside＝留出、暂留；route＝路线；mention＝提起；price card＝价牌。

## 理解问题

1. 大纸花了多少共同钱？买完后现金和库存各是多少？
2. Anna问起星期六时，Ronan有没有解释新增的八点半早单？Leo怎样提醒他？

## 读句子

**Every book is still two yuan.**

拆开看：Every book / is still / two yuan.

每本书／仍然是／两元。
